verdict.rationale: Oneleet's frameworks page names ISO 27001 among the frameworks it supports, and the docs describe adding and removing frameworks with default controls, so ISO 27001 is a selectable framework in the product. The pack does not show it is first-class beyond a framework listing and cross-framework control mapping. missing for 10: evidence of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation, ISO certification-audit artifacts or auditor workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of ISO 27001 depth.

support.subject: As a security engineer, ISO 27001 is a first-class framework — the current Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability, and certification-audit artifacts are supported, not just mapped

citations.quote: Whether you need SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, or another framework. Oneleet's all-in-one platform simplifies your compliance journey.
Adding the framework again restores its missing default controls.
Map a control once and it counts for every framework.
